scope: 4.3 fixed contextual replay with model-specific frozen same-card B0

qwen35-burst.policy: 4096 prefill budget for a single decode lane in 32K mixed steps

qwen35-small-mixed.policy: 4096 for one decode and 2048 for multiple decodes in 32K mixed steps

qwen9b-mixed-wave.policy: 3072 mixed graph under at least four decode lanes

qwen9b-pure-front.policy: longest remaining pure prefill under cold long-request fan-out

qwen9b-small-mixed.policy: cold pure prefill progress and 2048 graph for 32K with at least two decodes

intern-mixed-2048.policy: 2048 mixed graph for long Intern requests
